senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (मेदति)
1 To be proud.
2 To be humble.
r. 10th cl. (मेदयति) (इ) मिदि r. 1st and 10th cls. (मिन्दति मिन्दयति) also (ञि, आ,) ञिमिदा r. 1st cl. (मेदते) r. 4th cl. (मेद्यति)
1 To be unctuous, to be oily or greasy.
2 To liquefy, to melt.
3 To [] anoint.
4 To have affection or regard for.
5 To be soft, (literally or figuratively.)
(ऋ) मिदृ r. 1st cl. (मेदति-ते)
1 To understand.
2 To hurt, to injure.

n. (-द्धं)
1 Sloth, indolence.
2 Sleepiness, torpor.
3 Dulness, heaviness of spirits or intellect.
